questions.question_text: Find the next term and the nth term in each of the following sequences. 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, ...

Complete the cumulative frequency table for the plants.

Vito lives in Sicily. Table A shows the distances, in km, between different towns. Table B shows the average speed, in km/h, that Vito drives his car between towns. Write down the distance from Agrigento to Messina.
Find the time taken for Vito to drive from Agrigento to Messina.
On another day, Vito drives from Agrigento to Trapani. He arrives at Trapani at 1042. At what time did he leave Agrigento?
One day Vito drives from Catania to Palermo. Vito's car uses fuel at the rate of 12.5 km/litre. The cost of fuel is 1.432 euros per litre. Find the cost of this journey.
